hypothesis: A fixed 2020 ETH/BTC log-price relation predicts seven-day convergence in seen 2021 training development history; this differs from rolling return-beta residual momentum.
pair_choice: Fixed major liquid pair with recovered public coverage; not selected by prior DOGE loss, pair grid or post-2021 results.
model: log(ETH)=alpha+beta*log(BTC), one intercept OLS fit; residual mean/std ddof1 only fitted on 2020 completed daily closes
train_relation_gate: beta>0, residual scale>0, augmented Engle-Granger p<0.05; statsmodels coint(trend='c',maxlag=1,autolag=None), no lag search
prediction_dates: Monday UTC decisions 2021-01-11 through 2021-12-20 inclusive; seven-day mature labels ending by 2021-12-27
purge: No supervised fit labels; first evaluation decision embargoed more than7 days after final fit close; nonoverlapping seven-day Monday outcomes, no label past 2021 cutoff
causal_inputs: completed prices at decision only, fixed2020 model and scale, past30 daily simple return covariance, exact BTC/ETH identity/common finite mask
mechanism: At weekly decision with abs(z)>=1, reverse deviation sign. Hold signal seven days with daily causal risk scaling; no early profit stop or re-entry tuning.
control: Same fixed pair, beta hedge, z>=1 availability mask and risk kernel; direction from past seven-day fixed-beta log-spread momentum. CASH descriptive baseline, no oracle.
intent: ETH weight0.30*direction and BTC weight=-beta*ETH; uniform prescale before existing signed covariance risk kernel to abs .30/gross .60 and annual vol .10. SAME algorithm, not promised equal realized risk.
predictive_increment_gate: At least12 active mature observations per H1/H2; positive mean reversion portfolio seven-day simple-return proxy and positive mean paired increment over spread-momentum control in BOTH halves; pooled Pearson correlation between -z and future fixed-beta log-spread change positive. No retry after failed gate.
cost_proxy: Report 27bp per full roundtrip of gross entry weights on weekly outcomes as conservative explanatory proxy; not spendable or learned net收益, no funding oracle
economic_gate: Only if relation AND predictive gates pass: at most four new independent10k wallets (reversion/control x RAW_AS_FRACTION/RAW_AS_PERCENT), one fixed already-seen Apr5-Jun7 2021 recovered minute episode, fully charged existing shared kernel, actual funding timestamps, risk reductions and terminal closure. Failure means NOT_RUN, no forced wallet.
economic_scope: Binance tape with declared Bybit cost/MMR assumption, modern mark-MM liquidation rules on old prices, no native2021 certification, no close-fee reserve implementation, fixed unpaid-HALT v2 source binding

data.projection: Only BTC/ETH completed daily price columns and dt<=2021; no2023/2024 outcome projection

roles: 2020 calibration, 2021 already-seen training/development validation, no pristine out-of-sample claim. 2026 locked data unopened.
seeds: No stochastic fit. Any later bootstrap fixed811107; no seed selection.
stop: Failure of fixed stationarity or prediction increment gates stops THIS pair/one-year-calibration/seven-day-convergence recipe. No parameter, threshold, pair or window rescue.
